question: What width is prescribed for the crown pot on the head?
premises: The measurement is on the head.
The width of the pot is specified.
inference: The width of the crown pot on the head is three finger-widths each.
uncertainties: guṇāṅgulam is taken as three finger-widths based on symbolic association.
plain_english: On the head, the width of the crown pot is three finger-widths each.
